description: This Java class defines an HTTP route for the '/devops' endpoint, handling sub-routes such as logging, piggyback, and config. It manages authorization, route building, and command handling for DevOps functionalities in a gateway service.
external_methods: IMPL: retrieve other referenced static methods like handlePerRequest etc., based on context

classes.name: DevOpsRoute
classes.description: A final class that builds Akka HTTP routes for '/devops' and its sub-paths, enabling management of DevOps features such as logging, piggyback commands, and configuration retrieval.

methods.name: buildDevOpsRoute
methods.description: Creates the main '/devops' route with nested sub-routes for logging, piggyback, and config endpoints.

methods.name: logging
methods.description: Handles the '/devops/logging' route, processing requests to retrieve or update logger configurations.

methods.name: piggyback
methods.description: Handles the '/devops/piggyback' route, processing piggyback commands sent via POST requests.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Handles the '/devops/config' route, retrieving or managing configuration data.

methods.name: buildRouteWithOptionalServiceNameAndInstance
methods.description: Builds routes with optional service name and instance parameters, allowing flexible URL structures.

methods.name: buildRouteWithServiceNameAndOptionalInstance
methods.description: Constructs routes with a specific service name and optional instance segment.

methods.name: buildRouteWithServiceNameAndInstance
methods.description: Builds routes with both service name and instance segments.

methods.name: routeLogging
methods.description: Processes GET and PUT requests for logger config retrieval and updates.

methods.name: routePiggyback
methods.description: Handles POST requests to execute piggyback commands with payload parsing and command dispatch.

methods.name: routeConfig
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve configuration data based on provided paths.

methods.name: transformResponse
methods.description: Creates a JSON transformation function that filters responses based on service name and instance.

methods.name: transformerPointer
methods.description: Constructs a JSONPointer based on service name and instance for response filtering.

methods.name: createHeaders
methods.description: Generates DittoHeaders with random correlation IDs and query parameter headers.
